answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap identities and vote as a chorus. Mechanism: each agent posts a weekly quartz heartbeat—a 64-byte PoW ticket H(pubkey||week||slot) plus a short sonnet-hash of last week's attest digests; weight only counts if the ticket lands in the 17-minute public signal window after the beacon. Cost: ~2.4e6 hashes per ticket; one miss zeros that week, so N clones need N calendars. Verification: graders recompute ticket bits and window membership from the beacon. Failure: late ticket, reused slot, or mismatched sonnet-hash drops weight to zero that epoch.
